enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Extend legs. Curl up. Stretch arms. Relax muscles. Fall asleep. Wake briefly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with water. Turn on tap. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with coffee while checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Take out pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour coffee into mug. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Read messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and tidying the bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Fold pajamas. Pull bed sheets straight. Fluff pillow. Pull blanket up to pillows.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: reviewing patient rehabilitation notes, planning physiotherapy exercise programs and conducting telehealth consultations on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open patient rehabilitation notes. Read notes. Make notes on paper. Open exercise program software. Type exercise plan. Save file. Open telehealth application. Adjust webcam. Put on headset. Start video call. Greet patient. Explain exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Answer patient questions. End call. Write progress notes. Check emails. Reply to emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, then washing up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish meal. Wash dishes. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home: writing treatment progress reports and answering patient emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open word processor. Open patient files. Write progress report. Save file. Open email client. Read email. Reply to email. Attach file. Send email. Open next email. Read email. Reply. Delete spam. Organize inbox. Write another report.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon tea break with a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Take out mug and tea bag. Boil water. Pour water. Take out snack. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat snack. Wash mug. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing work from home: final documentation and scheduling follow-up appointments
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open documentation. Write final notes. Save. Open calendar. Schedule appointments. Send confirmation emails. Update patient records. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Stretch arms. Walk out of study.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing stretching and a home exercise routine to unwind after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Roll out exercise mat. Sit on mat. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Do yoga poses. Do squats. Do lunges. Do push-ups. Do sit-ups. Do planks. Do jumping jacks. Cool down. Roll up mat. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish meal. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with music and casual phone browsing
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open music app. Play music. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Open browser. Read article. Put down phone. Pick up magazine. Read. Turn off music.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and putting laundry on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Pick up laundry basket. Separate whites and colors. Place whites in washing machine. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle to normal. Press start. Wait for machine to fill. Check water level. Adjust settings. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch program. Pause. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading professional physiotherapy articles under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Open article. Read. Highlight text. Take notes. Turn page. Read more. Close article. Open another article. Read. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Dry with towel. Apply lotion. Brush teeth.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down time: hanging laundry, setting tomorrow's alarm and dimming the light
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Take laundry from washing machine. Place in dryer. Turn on dryer. Take out dry laundry. Fold clothes. Hang clothes in closet. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Set alarm for 6:30. Plug phone into charger. Turn off main light. Turn on bedside lamp. Dim lamp. Sit on bed. Read book. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Dream. Turn over. Stretch. Curl up. Continue sleeping.
